q: Mixing the primary colors RED and YELLOW produces the secondary color ____. (P2)

q: A traditional African percussion instrument played by beating with hands or sticks is a ____. (P2)
explain: Drums provide rhythmic drive across African cultures.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Talking drum (Gangan / Kalangu)?
options: an hourglass-shaped drum whose pitch changes by squeezing leather cords
explain: The Talking drum (Gangan / Kalangu) is an hourglass-shaped drum whose pitch changes by squeezing leather cords.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Kakaki?
options: a very long metal royal trumpet used in Northern Nigerian ceremonies
explain: The Kakaki is a very long metal royal trumpet used in Northern Nigerian ceremonies.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Shekere?
options: a dried gourd covered with a woven bead net shaken for rhythm
explain: The Shekere is a dried gourd covered with a woven bead net shaken for rhythm.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Ogene?
options: a traditional forged iron double-bell gong played in Igbo music
explain: The Ogene is a traditional forged iron double-bell gong played in Igbo music.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Goje?
options: a traditional one- or two-stringed bowed fiddle with a gourd resonator
explain: The Goje is a traditional one- or two-stringed bowed fiddle with a gourd resonator.

q: Traditional instrument (P2): What is a Udu?
options: a water jug clay vessel drum tapped to produce deep bass tones
explain: The Udu is a water jug clay vessel drum tapped to produce deep bass tones.
